profile.headline: QA Engineer and SDET | Test Automation | AI-Assisted Testing | Release Quality
profile.summary:
I help teams create clarity in complex systems, so they can trust what they ship.

I've worked as a tester, SDET, and quality manager across healthcare, banking, accounting SaaS, sports and events, and nonprofit settings. Today my work centers on quality engineering: test strategy, automation, release quality, and the documentation that helps a team understand what it's building.

Recently, at a regional bank, I've been automating regression testing for monthly vendor releases, work aimed at cutting a cycle of more than four weeks down to about two. Along the way I built a working model of the application and a knowledge base of the gotchas, and I'm building an AI agent that can act as a junior tester the team hands work to. At an accounting SaaS company, I engineered an AI scrum master that helped orchestrate our development process and communication with the rest of the company, and I moved our issue tracking from GitLab to Jira.

What connects my work is a deep interest in how people, systems, and decisions come together. I do my best work when I can listen for what's really needed, ask good questions, and write it down clearly enough that others can act on it.

My path has not been about having all the answers from the start, but about learning how to move through complexity with curiosity, steadiness, and adaptability. I bring a calm, systems-oriented presence to high-pressure releases.

I'm increasingly focused on AI-assisted testing: using AI in practical, responsible ways that reduce friction and strengthen quality without creating unnecessary complexity.

Alongside this work, I am an ordained Presbyterian minister and have spent more than a decade in congregational ministry and community outreach. That experience shaped how I listen, build trust, and help people through ambiguity with both clarity and care.

At heart, I'm motivated by work that helps people flourish. I care about creating environments where individuals are supported in growing, contributing, and pursuing the well-being of their families, communities, and the organizations they are part of.

Core strengths
- Test strategy and automation
- AI-assisted testing and workflow tools
- Release quality and risk visibility
- Requirements clarity and documentation
- Systems and process improvement
- Clear communication in complex environments

Domains
- Healthcare
- Banking and Mortgage
- Nonprofit
- Sports and Events
- Retail
- Public Utilities
- Accounting and Business Services

positions.title: Quality Manager
positions.description:
Mission: Build clarity, confidence, and consistency in how Firm360 delivers software by aligning teams, improving visibility, and strengthening quality systems.

Impact and Responsibilities:
• Lead release readiness and risk management across frequent production releases, improving confidence and reducing escaped defects
• Establish quality as a shared responsibility across product, engineering, and customer success through cross-functional alignment and communication
• Design and implement visibility frameworks that provide clear insight into release health, risk, and system behavior
• Facilitate structured bug triage and team-based testing practices to improve issue discovery and resolution speed
• Define and evolve quality strategy, balancing speed, risk, and team capacity in a high-growth environment
• Partner with leadership to identify critical workflows and prioritize testing and monitoring efforts
• Explore and apply AI-assisted approaches to testing, analysis, and workflow efficiency
positions.insights: Skills: Automated Software Testing · Quality Management · Release Engineering · Cross-functional Team Leadership · Artificial Intelligence (AI)

positions.title: SDET III
positions.description:
• Led the design of a cross-platform mobile testing strategy, enabling whole-team ownership of quality
• Built and scaled automation frameworks that improved coverage and reduced manual testing effort
• Partnered with engineering to integrate testing into delivery workflows, increasing release confidence
• Helped establish quality practices that aligned speed, reliability, and team collaboration

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
• Contributed to modernization of end-to-end testing strategy during platform transition
• Expanded automation coverage across web, mobile, and API layers to improve system reliability
• Collaborated across teams to identify high-risk workflows and prioritize testing efforts
• Supported delivery of a large-scale healthcare communication platform with a focus on quality and stability
